identifier.value: Blockchain based Digital Passport for Travelers is similar to VeriFLY

overview_description.description: 1ID is accelerator funded Travel Tech startup specialized in touchless immigration and security clearance solutions that provides digital passports for travelers and real-time Arrival and Departure Control Dashboards for airports. 1ID creates digital identities for travelers through its Digital Passport platform and issues a unique virtual identification number using facial verification that is stored on blockchain. Data can be uploaded by passport holders themselves via the mobile app. Airport immigration officials have access to the 1ID dashboard which allows them to see all relevant information about a traveler without having to physically check their passport.
